data.answer: Stella Valle Jewelry was founded in 2009 by sisters Ashley Jung and Paige Dellavalle, inspired by their military service. The company initially sold charm bracelets and necklaces, and by 2020, it made 90% of its sales online. However, as of 2023, Stella Valle no longer has an active website, and its social media accounts have been inactive since 2022. The brand is primarily sold on Amazon, where it offers cuff bracelets, charm necklaces, and rings, with prices ranging from $5.99 to $40.99.

## About Stella Valle Jewelry

Stella Valle Jewelry creates charm jewelry for young women within the fashion industry. Their offerings include charm bracelets and necklaces designed to be layered and stacked, providing a personalized accessory option. The company targets a demographic interested in meaningful jewelry. It was founded in 2009 and is based in Hillsborough Township, New Jersey.

## Headquarters Location [...] The Stella Valle is a jewelry line inspired by two West Point Cadet Army Officers and Sisters Paige Dellavalle and Ashley Jung. The two very close sister's completed their commitment to our country back in 2009 and started the Stella Valle jewelry Line to compliment the more edgier side the military brings out in you. Transforming back to civilian life after years in the service takes time for anyone that has gone through the process. Helping to bring back their feminine side, but not forget where they came from, is what the Stella Valle Jewelry Line represents. Ashley and Paige also have two other sisters that are still in the military, but apparently not in the Stella Valle Business just yet as they are both still on active duty. Paige donned one of our very best sellers, the Rio De Janeiro ring, that has been featured in almost every fashion mag you can think of from Harper’s Bazaar to InStyle to PeopleStyleWatch. She created an arm party similar to the one Gwen Stefani wore as the cover girl for Cosmopolitan with The Year 2051 bangle, a customize The Year 2050 bangle with her wedding date in roman numerals, The Year 2052 square bracelet, and the Ferris Wheel Flight bangle. Our Stella Valle Belgium bracelets are perfect to add into your stack or wear alone. These are a favorite among fashion bloggers, too- another must-have for Fall. [...] We’ll let you in on some little known facts on Stella Valle jewelry making. First, all of the pieces are designed on computer software and then 3-D printed as part of the mold development process. That’s right, we use the best high-tech equipment so that each piece comes out just perfect. Secondly, the pieces are plated in 14K Gold and Rhodium. Most people don’t know what Rhodium is—it is a natural metal that is more expensive than silver, doesn’t tarnish, and doesn’t wear easily! Thirdly, each of the crystals in every piece are hand set. It was absolutely crazy to watch the factory employees set the 134 teeny tiny crystals in the Aspire Bracelet. Can you say, patience?!
